intro: Every dish balances sweet, sour, salty and spicy, with fresh herbs, lime and fish sauce. Bangkok street food is a world benchmark.
flavours: Fish sauce, lime, palm sugar, chilli, lemongrass, galangal, coconut milk, Thai basil
hk: Kowloon City is Hong Kong's 'Little Thailand', packed with Thai grocers and restaurants.

dishes.name: Pad thai
dishes.what: Stir-fried rice noodles with tamarind, egg, tofu, prawns and peanuts.

dishes.name: Tom yum goong
dishes.what: Hot and sour prawn soup, fragrant with lemongrass and lime leaf.

dishes.name: Green curry
dishes.local: แกงเขียวหวาน
dishes.what: Coconut curry coloured by green chillies, often with chicken and Thai aubergine.

dishes.name: Massaman curry
dishes.local: แกงมัสมั่น
dishes.what: Mild, sweet curry with Persian-influenced spices, potatoes and peanuts.

dishes.name: Som tam
dishes.what: Pounded green papaya salad from Isan: crunchy, sour, fiery.

dishes.name: Pad kra pao
dishes.what: Minced pork or chicken stir-fried with holy basil and chilli, over rice with a fried egg.

dishes.name: Khao soi
dishes.what: Northern Thai curry noodle soup topped with crispy fried noodles.

dishes.name: Tom kha gai
dishes.what: Creamy coconut chicken soup scented with galangal.

dishes.name: Mango sticky rice
dishes.local: ข้าวเหนียวมะม่วง
dishes.what: Sweet coconut sticky rice with ripe mango slices.
